notes.title: MEANDERS - Extra Levels Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/9db3211fe64302f314f33ffdbe6299ce5e1e3211.gif
Hi all!
Update 9 is live!

NEW LEVELS AVAILABLE!
With this update we introduce 10 new extra levels that we couldn't fit in the original game experience: hope you’ll enjoy them!!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/700be72172fca24dee50db1ef67bf2d237bc78d3.png
KITES IN THE SKY
The flying kites make their appearance! We’ve had them in mind for a while – the most attentive of you might have noticed them in the game’s art – but didn’t have a chance to introduce them since now. If you feel free like the wind or you want to give your dragons some company, give them a try.

RUSSIAN LOCALIZATION
Russian is now available for everyone and the efforts to localize the game continue day and night thanks to our amazing community!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33022492/4cf9b2799aef699f7a1a3bcff455ed214e233a22.png

If you want to help, even just a bit, here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: Overchunked - Shuriken Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452586/8c2c1eff91070a46872ae0a86661865865fb230e.gif

Hello there!

Update 3 is live!

SHURIKEN SKIN 
Do you want to show off your mad ninja skills?!
New "Shuriken" skin available!!

BEACH BALLS!
To kick Summer in the right direction and celebrate the awesome Summer Sales we introduce... Beach Balls!
These bouncy little friends spawn on the map and you can send them towards TNT bombs to detonate them (pretty useful, right?)

The game is also on a 20% discount!

NEW BUMP VISUAL FILTER
New visual filter for all you fashionable people!

LOCALIZATION UPDATED
Our translation and localization efforts continue, thank you all for the support so far!
Updated: Catalan, Chinese (Simplified), Czech, Danish, Estonian, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish, Ukrainian
New: Norwegian, Polish, Korean

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452586/2704b090679a29f3a388fd5a76a1529496181b2a.png

If you want to help, even just a bit, here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

*Added Shuriken Skin
*Added Beach Balls
*Added Bump visual filter
*Improved tall TNT obstacle hit detection and explosion
*Improved collisions of individual chunks
*Moving walls are now properly randomized

notes.title: Overchunked - Dynamic Camera Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452586/a1932c65ffef8a1284cdf450687ef09d7282dee3.gif

Hello there!

Update 2 is live!

DYNAMIC CAMERA OPTION
Inside the Gameplay settings, the camera angle can now be switched between fixed (static) and dynamic (camera rotates).
For the dynamic camera, you can also adjust the camera lag amount to better match your taste!

USER INTERFACE VISIBILITY IMPROVED
To enhance visibility a thin black shadow has been added to all UI components and texts.
With further updates, we will also add the options to change the UI color like in MEANDERS.
This change also improved visibility when the Inverted visual filter is enabled.  

5 NEW LANGUAGES ADDED
Big update for the game localization!
The following languages have been added:
Catalan, Czech, Danish, Estonian, Ukrainian
If you would like to help with other languages, even just a bit, here's the link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/

SOUNDTRACK UPDATED
The Official Soundtrack has been expanded with 4 new tracks!
We also set correct metadata for all the MP3 tracks: now, if imported in software like iTunes, the tracks are correctly detected!

CHANGELOG 1.03
*Added Dynamic Camera Option
*Added UI shadow
*Fixed a bug with Boost feature when pausing the game
*Fixed a bug with Boost sound when pausing the game
*Fixed a menu navigation bug

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH

notes.title: Overchunked - Post Launch Update + Help us Translate!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32452586/d95ba18d8a5f8bdddaf7f99008fa0ed3f18021d6.gif

Hello there!

Update 1 is live!

Are you having a good, merry time with Overchunked?!

Yes: good, consider posting a review then, that will help us immensely!
No: well, let others know what sh*t they’re buying by writing guess what… a review! 


CHANGELOG 1.02
*Added the credits section
*Fixed leaderboards rank not displaying correctly
*Fixed minor bugs with menus navigation
*Improved visualization of leaderboards rank

GAME LOCALIZATION
We’d love to translate Overchunked to all the languages spoken on planet Earth, and while our experts are all focused preparing the version in Egyptian hieroglyphs, we’d like to rely on your support for the more standard languages.

We've set up a nice translation tool powered by OneSky: it’s extremely beginner-friendly and allows everyone to do things at their own pace. If you want to contribute – even just a bit – you just have to:

[OLIST]
Go to this link: http://atomicbreath.oneskyapp.com/collaboration/
Select in which manner you would like to help us, namely:
Game texts (102 Words)
Steam Page texts (137 Words)
Select which language you want to translate it to (If your language is not listed, please report to us)
Create an account for free to start translating!
Thanks!!
[/OLIST]

Best,
ATOMIC BREATH
